ctx.x: Lucille. Her name was Lucille Avery. And she lived just a block from Central Avenue, on the east side. And my cousin, one of my cousins, knew everybody on the avenue, because they lived in that neighborhood, they'd been living there for many years because my aunt had been out here for a number of years. And he was instrumental in introducing me to some of the folks, you know, on the avenue.
